step1_analysis.circuit_type: Symmetrical Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) / Differential Receiver
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed symmetrical OTA used as a differential receiver or comparator. It converts small differential input signals (like PECL or LVDS) into full-swing single-ended CMOS logic levels.

paper_reference.title: 1.2-Gb/s True PECL 100K Compatible I/O Interface in 0.35-m CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm = 2*Id/Vov = 2*100uA/0.27V = 740uS. Rout = ro5 || ro6 = 100k || 100k = 50kOhm. Gain = Gm * Rout = 37 V/V = 31.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law model with lambda=0.1/V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * C_load). With Rout=50kOhm and C_load=50fF, BW = 63.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the assumed load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = Gm / (2 * pi * C_load) = 740uS / (2 * pi * 50fF) = 2.35 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with transconductance and load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Slew rate = I_tail / C_load = 200uA / 50fF = 4 V/ns. Delay to VDD/2 (0.9V) is approx 0.9V / 4V/ns = 225 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the order of magnitude reported in the paper, adjusted for sky130 and 50fF load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current = I_tail + I_M5 + I_M2 = 200uA + 100uA + 100uA = 400uA. Power = 400uA * 1.8V = 720 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower than paper due to 1.8V supply vs 3.3V/5V in the original paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for Symmetrical OTA / Receiver measuring AC gain, bandwidth, transient delay, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Symmetrical OTA / Receiver Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 LABEL_NET_1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_tail N4 0 200u
C_load N0 0 50f

V_in_plus LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.85 0.95 0.5n 50p 50p 0.95n 2n)
V_in_minus LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.9 AC 0 PULSE(0.95 0.85 0.5n 50p 50p 0.95n 2n)

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N0)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N0))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when phase=-45 fall=1
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran tpd_rise trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran tpd_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran trise trig v(N0) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.44 rise=1
  meas tran tfall trig v(N0) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.36 fall=1
  
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas tran avg_power avg power
  
  print dc_gain bw_3db gbw tpd_rise tpd_fall trise tfall avg_power
  quit
.endc
.end
